author: Yffe
content: Failing test pinned at forge/tests/divergence_collections.rs::divergence_push_one_l3_not_mutation_gated_l0 (#[ignore = blocker #74]). ROOT CAUSE: push_one PROVES at verus L3 on the per-item forge::check path (golden tests/golden/lower/vec_demo.verus.rs = 4 verified, 0 errors), but #12 mutation scoring cannot synthesize an early-return mutant for a Vec<u64> (Type::Vec) return — forge::mutation::early_return_value/zero_value_for return None for Type::Vec — so kill ratio is 0/0 and the #48 backstop (check.rs lines ~487-501) gates the L3-proved cert to a WeakContract reject -> Level::L0. Oracle conformance/collections/cases.json says push_one -> L3 (fx alloc). NOT a Vec-wrapper-weave or push-composition bug: emit_vec_wrappers IS woven into the per-item subprogram, and a wrong ens (len+2) is correctly caught by verus (postcondition not satisfied), as is an unguarded push (req true -> L0). FIX is in forge::mutation: synthesize a Vec early-return mutant (e.g. a default/empty TVec, or skip mutation gating for Vec returns until a synthesis exists). The builder's collections_conformance.rs test never exercised forge check (whole-program lower + direct verus only) — same gap class as #68.
